text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which means goals that are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to accomplish. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline that show progress. Deliverables, the final products or results, should be agreed on from the start. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters because everyone involved needs to share the same expectations. When goals are clear and all parties agree, projects are more likely to finish on time and within budget.
